maria: Heads-up — after the int4 quant rollout for parasol-compact-1b-q4 we started seeing ~0.6% schema failures on tool-invoke paths (JSON parse errors). Dashboard: https://dash.internal/runs/4991 (spike at 03:12 UTC)
josh: repro logs? sample payloads? any obvious suffix/truncation?
anita: grabbed a couple of failed payloads, looks like an extra control token sneaks into the JSON right before the closing bracket. example: `\{"action\": \"upsert\", \"items\": [ {...} ]<|TRACE|>}` — parser chokes on `<|TRACE|>`
alex: interesting — kernel fallback to fallback-kernel-2 was triggered on longer histories during quantized run. fallback kernel appends tracing sentinel for debug and apparently we forgot to strip it in streaming mode :facepalm:
maria: reproduction steps I used: run canary with the streaming kv-cache enabled + longer convo context (~900 tokens). repro-bot posted a quick script:
repro-bot: ```bash
# quick canary
curl -X POST https://canary.internal/invoke \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CANARY' \ 
  -d '{"model":"parasol-compact-1b-q4","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"<long conversation...>"}],"tools":[{"id":"db_upsert","schema":{}}]}'
```
josh: so this is two failures combined: kernel debug sentinel + streaming chunk boundary where sentinel lands inside a token boundary -> broken JSON. any parsing middleware that could auto-strip known sentinels before schema validation?
anita: I tried a quick postprocess in the client that strips `<|TRACE|>` and also collapses stray newline-only chunks. simple python snippet:
```
import re
clean = re.sub(r"<\|TRACE\|>", "", raw)
clean = re.sub(r"\n{2,}", "\n", clean)
```
nina: product note — this hit a few canary customers on Dedicated, they saw 400s intermittently. Need a hotfix and follow-up: auto-sanitize at runtime + kernel change to not emit sentinels in production.
alex: infra plan: push runtime sanitizer as a small middleware that runs before JSON parse. will gate behind feature flag and enable for parasol-compact canary. also patch kernel to disable emit in non-dev builds.
maria: can we add a lightweight unit test that exercises a streaming chunk split in the middle of the sentinel? e.g., force chunk boundary between `<|TRACE` and `|>`
josh: yep, test idea: mock streaming generator that yields `[..."<|TRACE", "|>"]` and assert postprocess merges/strips -> result valid JSON. I'll add to eng-ml/streaming-tests.
repro-bot: test snippet uploaded: https://ci.internal/job/4991/stream-sentinel-split
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: runtime-sanitize-v1 -> canary cluster at 4991230100, rollout 5% -> 100% in 15m if no errors
anita: quick mitigation note — increasing parse-retry budget masked some failures but it also amplified duplicate tool invocations. avoid retry for 400s that are schema errors :warning:
maria: action items: (1) infra: runtime sanitizer feature-flag rollout (alex) (2) kernel: remove sentinel emission in prod builds (alex) (3) eng-ml: add split-sentinel streaming unit + end-to-end canary (josh/anita) (4) product: notify affected customers and add postmortem if any SLA blips (nina)
alex: will open PRs today and post links here
josh: PR for tests: https://git.internal/eng-ml/stream-tests/pull/72
alex: runtime PR: https://git.internal/infra/runtime/pull/891
anita: kernel patch: https://git.internal/infra/kernels/pull/204 (WIP)
maria: thanks everyone — keeping this thread as single-source for follow-ups. ping me @maria if you need access to the canary traces.
